contract.question: Can predeclared arrival looks plus fixed class-completion exposure checkpoints reduce abstention versus anytime rectangles without receiving population parameters or future information?
contract.observations: Only arrivals/needs/completion ids and times through arrival cutoff A_H. Reconstruct FCFS starts; V_j(t)=integral running class-job count, includes unfinished work. At fixed Kth class completion, record V_j(t_K), not sum of completed job durations. Largest attained predeclared milestone may be selected; no true service, population parameters or future times passed to inference.
contract.proof: Under independent class-exponential service with predictable R_j(t), compensator mu_j V_j(t) is continuous, unbounded on the infinite arrival process and nonexplosive. Existing random-time-change theorem gives a unit-rate Poisson process in compensator time; hence 2 mu_j V_j(t_K) ~ chi-square(2K) at each fixed completion count K. Availability selection at A_H does not create conditional coverage: all fixed-K failure events are union-bounded unconditionally, and a selected eligible failure is a subset. Do not assert conditional coverage after selection or use a Gamma pivot at random observed completion count.
contract.error_allocation: Joint scheduled family .05: each of arrival rate and class probability uses .05/4 divided by three fixed H looks (chi-square and binomial CP respectively). Each of two service rates uses .05/4 divided by thirteen fixed K milestones. Union bound across six arrival/mark intervals and26service intervals, no independence assumption. Guarantee for scheduled reports only, not arbitrary stopping times.
contract.comparator_scopes: ANYTIME_RECT keeps EP24 Gamma/Beta likelihood-mixture CS with four-way .0125, valid anytime under model. CHECKPOINT_RECT uses narrower scheduled reporting contract and rectangle capacity. KNOWN_SCHEDULED knows true capacity, arrival intervals .05/3. ALLOC_SCHEDULED knows capacity but same arrival interval .05/(4*3) as checkpoint. PLUGIN_MLE uses same past full exposure, no error control.
contract.capacity: Known two-class specialization 1/X=(1-p)/mu_big+p(2-p)/(2mu_small). Existing rectangle helper includes interior p extremum and outward rational conversion; no new capacity theorem.
contract.gate: Exact model/log declaration schema must match sealed synthetic generator contract. Unconfirmed/out-of-scope/missing/extra metadata => UNKNOWN without inference. This checks declarations, not data truth, exponential fit, log completeness or real-world validity. Seven negative declarations and two unscheduled-report cases verified before seal.
contract.budget: 160 workloads,20fresh seeds each model/load,3nested looks,5methods=2400decisions; max1280000arrivals per workload=204800000generated jobs. No expansion or timing-based peeking; seeds reused across load/model cells, independent repetition within cell.
contract.rates: CP family .05 over240 wrong/UNKNOWN cell rates and80anylook rates. Each seed counted once if any of3looks is wrong; all-look UNKNOWN separately. n20 => wide intervals; zero errors never imply zero risk.
contract.loss: e+a u, truth-conditioned, no online expected-loss recommendation
contract.stop_rule: Measure full grid even if wrong/UNKNOWN or prediction fail. First source/hash mismatch, nonfinite/invalid input, native checkpoint mismatch>1e-6 or departure mismatch>1e-7, capacity enclosure failure when true nuisance values are covered => R3 stop, no threshold/seed/budget tuning.
